intent: A native radio-card group with generous typographic options, concise tradeoffs and keyboard selection for assistant settings, formats or service modes.

layout.direction: A native radio group presented as three response-style cards, with a 20px group heading, 18px option labels, 14px descriptions and 12px monospaced notes. Each card pairs a quiet direction icon with a clear circular selection mark. Keep neutral graphite surfaces, 20px card padding and generous spacing; form-control boundaries meet 3:1 contrast. Use three columns only when the component container is wide enough, otherwise stack cards.
layout.container: Fill the parent up to 768px with 24px padding; card columns respond to the fieldset container.
layout.demo: A quiet stage with min-height max(560px,100dvh); the published920px preview retains all three stacked choices at320px and390px.
layout.readonly: Keep controlled choices legible while their native inputs are read-only without a writer; reserve dimming for unavailable options.

motion.entrance: Enter the fieldset once with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: Reveal a newly selected check with opacity and scale from 0.7 over 160ms; keep 150ms card press feedback.
motion.reduced: Subscribe to live prefers-reduced-motion changes. Stop and settle owned card/check entrances immediately and remove press transforms.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group legend and visible heading.

props.name: options
props.description: Unique stable IDs, labels, descriptions, optional notes and disabled state. Stable ID keys retain focused options through host reordering.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected option ID. Without onChange, the radios are read-only. An empty or unknown ID shows no selected option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous notification containing the selected ID from native pointer or keyboard radio selection. The host acknowledges controlled changes and owns persistence.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Preserve RadioCardOption, RadioCardsProps and the named RadioCards export. Use native radios inside labels and an instance-scoped fieldset group, with an accessible legend and visible heading.

Use defaultValue for local state, or value with onChange for controlled acknowledgement. Controlled radios without a writer are disabled. Retain the host selection when a proposal is refused; an empty or unknown ID is not selected.

Use stable unique option IDs as React keys so host reordering keeps the focused native radio. Keep arrow-key navigation and Space activation, skip disabled options and show visible focus around the entire card.
Keep selection marks and unchecked boundaries readable, with at least 3:1 boundary contrast. A disabled or read-only card must not offer hover or press transforms as if editable.
Empty and arriving option collections, long labels/descriptions/notes and independent groups must remain usable without shared radio names or document overflow.
onChange is a synchronous selected-ID notification. The host owns validation, persistence and any downstream assistant behavior.
